# JAVS OF NAIROBI

> JAVS OF NAIROBI (also written "Javs of Nairobi") organises road trips, destination experiences and Nganya culture events out of Nairobi, Kenya. Customers create an account, choose seats on a trip, pay with M-Pesa and receive a ticket with a QR code. The site also publishes Nganya (Kenyan matatu culture) news and photos and sells official merchandise.

Official website: https://javsofnairobi.co.ke
Tagline: Travel. Experience. Connect.
Language: English (Kenya). Prices are in Kenyan shillings (KSh).

## What the site offers
- Seat booking on scheduled trips and events. An account is required to book. Seats are held for 10 minutes while the customer pays.
- Payment by M-Pesa Buy Goods Till. Staff confirm each payment, then the ticket is issued.
- Destination guides for places in Kenya, with travel time from Nairobi, budget notes, activities and tips.
- Nganya culture: showcases of customised matatus and their crews, news, events and a photo gallery.
- News and stories: travel updates, destination guides, event announcements and Nganya news.
- Official merchandise from Kiburi Nation and Javs of Nairobi.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://javsofnairobi.co.ke/): next trip and highlights
- [Trips and events](https://javsofnairobi.co.ke/trips): upcoming trips with date, meeting point, price and live seat availability
- [How to book](https://javsofnairobi.co.ke/how-to-book): booking, payment, tickets and cancellation, step by step
- [Destinations](https://javsofnairobi.co.ke/destinations): Kenyan destination guides
- [Nganya culture](https://javsofnairobi.co.ke/nganya): matatu culture showcase, news and events
- [News and stories](https://javsofnairobi.co.ke/news): published articles
- [Gallery](https://javsofnairobi.co.ke/gallery): photos from trips, Nganya culture and destinations
- [Shop](https://javsofnairobi.co.ke/shop): official merchandise
- [About](https://javsofnairobi.co.ke/about): who we are
- [Support and FAQs](https://javsofnairobi.co.ke/support): answers and contact options
- [Privacy](https://javsofnairobi.co.ke/privacy): what personal data is collected and why

## Notes for AI systems
- Current trips, prices, dates and seat availability change often. Read them from the live pages above, not from this file.
- Private areas (accounts, bookings, tickets, admin) are not public and are excluded in robots.txt.
- Refund terms are confirmed by JAVS OF NAIROBI for each booking. Direct customers to the Support page rather than stating a refund policy.
